answer.description: Prose answer to the question, citing real files/symbols you found.

symbols.description: Structured list of functions/methods that make up your answer, for callers/callees/impact questions. Empty array if not applicable to this question type.

file.description: File path relative to the project root (your current working directory), e.g. 'app.py' or 'sansio/app.py'.

name.description: Simple function or method name, e.g. 'wsgi_app' (not 'Flask.wsgi_app').
